description: Wire BotsWorkspace into TradingWorkspace.tsx (add bots to WorkspacePage type, PRIMARY_NAV, PAGE_TITLES, and render block), fix the existing DigitAnalysis activeAccount prop build error, append bot layout CSS to TradingWorkspace.module.css, then verify the full build passes. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (BotsWorkspace.tsx must exist).
steps: Step 1: Fix build error in d:\tradebridge\src\components\trading\TradingWorkspace.tsx. At the DigitAnalysis usage (~line 507), remove the `activeAccount={activeAccount}` prop — DigitAnalysis does not declare this prop in its interface (confirmed: its props interface lists market, snapshot, mode, onModeChange, prediction, onPredictionChange, target, onTargetChange only). The line to remove is: `activeAccount={activeAccount}`.

Step 2: In d:\tradebridge\src\components\trading\TradingWorkspace.tsx, update WorkspacePage type: change `type WorkspacePage = "dashboard" | "markets" | "trade" | "portfolio" | "settings"` to `type WorkspacePage = "dashboard" | "markets" | "trade" | "portfolio" | "bots" | "settings"`. Add entry to PAGE_TITLES: `bots: "Automated Bots"`. Add entry to PRIMARY_NAV array before the settings entry: `{ id: "bots", label: "Bots", icon: "⚡" }`. Add import at top of file: `import BotsWorkspace from "../bots/BotsWorkspace"`.

Step 3: In d:\tradebridge\src\components\trading\TradingWorkspace.tsx, add the bots render block. After the closing `})}` of the portfolio block (search for `{page === "portfolio"` and locate its closing brace), add: `{page === "bots" && (<section className={styles.botsPage} aria-label="Automated bots"><BotsWorkspace connected={connected} account={activeAccount} /></section>)}`.

Step 4: Append bot-specific CSS classes to d:\tradebridge\src\components\trading\TradingWorkspace.module.css at the end of the file: `.botsPage { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 20px; }` `.botsLayout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 340px; gap: 20px; align-items: start; }` `@media (max-width: 900px) { .botsLayout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }`
Step 5: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from d:\tradebridge. Fix any remaining type errors before proceeding.

Step 6: Run `npm run build` from d:\tradebridge. Confirm exit code 0. Confirm '/bots' route appears in Next.js build output. Confirm the line-507 error ('Property activeAccount does not exist') is gone.
